comparison.objective: Install a temporary grounding set in the safe ground-first order.
comparison.physical_skill: Place clamps around bars, tighten eye screws to force, release, and withstand tug tests.
comparison.success_condition: Ground clamp must be tight before phase contact; both correct clamps must reach 120 N and survive 40 N pulls without touching wrong bars.
comparison.reason: The record tests safety sequencing, clamp placement, and torque/retention force. It does not test aligned sliding between continuous supports or rolling-element containment.
